notes: Mapping convention: EBIT is proxied by “income from operations” from the FY2025 Form 10-K income statement. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

D&A and capex are sourced from the FY2025 Form 10-K cash flow statement lines “Depreciation and amortization” and “Purchases of property, plant and equipment” (capex reported as an absolute cash outflow). ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

Net working capital (NWC) uses Cadence’s definition: current assets less current liabilities as shown on its consolidated balance sheets. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

Tax rate uses FY2025 effective tax rate computed from the FY2025 Form 10-K provision for income taxes and income before provision for income taxes. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

NOL balance is approximated from the “operating loss carryforwards” disclosure in deferred tax assets (amounts shown in thousands). NOL utilization percent is a modeling assumption (0.80) because no explicit utilization schedule is provided in this pass. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

Base-case WACC, terminal growth, and terminal method are not explicitly provided by management in the referenced materials; they are set as standardized DCF assumptions for modeling (see assumptions section).

catalysts: Closing and integration of the pending Hexagon design and engineering acquisition; management notes FY2026 outlook does not include its impact. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Sustained AI-driven product adoption across Cadence’s core EDA, IP, and System Design & Analysis offerings (reflected qualitatively in FY2025 results/outlook). ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Backlog conversion and enterprise customer expansion, which could accelerate revenue growth vs the base-case deceleration assumptions. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))
company_overview: Cadence is a provider of engineering design software (EDA) and related services that support silicon-to-systems innovation, positioned around AI and digital twins. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Revenue is reported across Core EDA, IP, and System Design and Analysis product categories. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/content/dam/cadence-www/global/en_US/documents/company/investors/form-10-k-2024.pdf))
FY2025 results show total revenue of $5.297 billion and income from operations of $1.492 billion. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))
current_context: Cadence reported FY2025 revenue growth of ~14% and a record backlog of $7.8 billion. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

For FY2026, management guided revenue of $5.9 billion to $6.0 billion and GAAP operating margin of 31.75% to 32.75% (guidance outlook excludes the pending Hexagon D&E acquisition impact). ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))
FY2025 GAAP operating margin was ~28.2% based on income from operations / total revenue. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))
investment_highlights: Base-case revenue growth leverages management’s FY2026 guidance anchor and assumes a gradual deceleration thereafter as the company compounds a large installed base. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

The base-case margin profile assumes normalization/re-expansion toward low- to mid-30% GAAP operating margin consistent with FY2026 guidance. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Cash flow modeling uses D&A, capex, and working-capital intensity aligned with FY2023–FY2025 history from the FY2025 Form 10-K. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

Scenario analysis applies only modest changes to growth and EBIT margin, reflecting uncertainty around macro/semiconductor demand and execution. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))
key_risks: Demand volatility in semiconductor and electronics systems markets, plus geopolitical/export-control and international macro risks, could pressure customer spending. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Acquisition execution/regulatory risk (including integration costs and timing) could affect margin and cash flow vs the modeled scenario ranges. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))

Working capital swings and cash conversion risk if the mix/timing of receivables and deferred revenue differs from historical patterns. ([sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/813672/000081367226000016/cdns-20251231.htm))

The base-case growth path uses FY2026 management guidance as the starting point and then assumes a gradual normalization consistent with mature software economics. ([cadence.com](https://www.cadence.com/en_US/home/company/newsroom/press-releases/pr-ir/2026/cadence-reports-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2025-financial.html))
